package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_gsynth.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Counterfactual imputation using interactive fixed effects
limitation: Latent-factor extrapolation and support require validation
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Treated/control panel and an interactive-fixed-effect counterfactual model.
scientific_qualification.output: Imputed untreated outcomes and their treatment contrasts.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Stable low-rank factor structure, sufficient untreated overlap, no relevant spillovers and justified extrapolation.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: README states gsynth is now a fect wrapper maintained for backward compatibility. Qualify and pin fect separately before implementation. README 1.3.1 and DESCRIPTION 1.4.0 are distinct declarations, not interchangeable release evidence.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use known low-rank factor panels and a treated-unit factor break; verify cross-validation excludes post-treatment leakage. Repeat against the actual pinned fect dependency.

evidence.finding: Interactive FE purpose, README version and fect/backward-compatibility notice.
